ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so this older model adds little.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a tablet right now, especially an older release.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a fourth-generation Dot and do not need an older duplicate.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to control a lamp through my existing Alexa devices, provided the lamp is compatible.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My 4K Max already handles streaming, and I have no immediate need for another stick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger display interests me, but my recently purchased Show 5 meets my current needs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This duplicates my streaming setup, and the themed cover gives me no practical reason to buy it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Heather Gray; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A different color does not justify adding an older Dot alongside my fourth-generation model.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Flex - Plug-in mini smart speaker with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have several Alexa devices and no specific location that needs another speaker.
